evidence: Current Java and Rust sources read and edited only; no build, test, syntax check, project/game execution or process inspection

producer.depthIndependentEntry: NativeBridge.worldGeometryFromFrame(json,session,sequence), (Ljava/lang/String;Ljava/lang/String;J)[B; native-geometry-input-source.json documents the shared validated no-readback input path
producer.staleResult: null for missing/unrenderable world, unavailable current input, changed session or different world sequence
producer.selection: WorldFrame.emitAvatars shared with the software render path; same acknowledged appearances, emote targets, cape frames and replay selections
producer.ownership: One bounded builder for the entire visible actor set; shared texture identity map; owned arrays and copied pixels
producer.actorOrder: Canonical lowercase UUIDs in visible emission order; batch actor indices are nondecreasing
producer.interleaving: A sink cannot resume after a subsequent draw or actor; incomplete quads reject the transaction

wire.magic: ARCGEO10 for explicit known model glint observations; otherwise v9 known owned simple-phase collector output, v8 model-submit boundaries, v7 owned supported Java factory references, v6 supplied Java layer eligibility, v5 logical texture identifiers, v4 skin visibility/bent skin, v3 explicit normal skin, v2 common material or v1 material-free geometry
headerOrder: session: u32 UTF-8 byte length then ASCII bytes, 1..64
world sequence u64; world clock milliseconds u64; cosmetic math time f64
replay flag u8; if 1: replay timeMs u64, remainder u32, denominator u32
width u32; height u32; coordinate space u8 (0 unknown,1 world,2 camera-relative)
dimension: u32 UTF-8 byte length then bytes, at most 256 bytes/64 UTF-16 units
camera: three f64; viewProjection: sixteen f32
equipment matrix flag u8; if 1: sixteen f32
ARCGEO02 and later: material flag u8; if 1: 1058 f32 shader/lightmap values, detailed in native-geometry-material-source.json
actor count u32; canonical UUID ASCII bytes, 36 each
batch count u32; texture count u32
batchOrder: actor index u16; pass u8; flags u8; texture index i32 (-1 for no texture)
tint: four f32; vertex count u32; index count u32
ARCGEO03 and later pass 6 only: four f32 body-overlay components before the vertex array
ARCGEO05 and later: logical texture ID presence u8 after any body overlay; if 1, u32 byte length plus at most 256 ASCII namespace:path bytes
ARCGEO07 and later: strict render-reference presence u8 after logical texture metadata; if 1, factory u8 then bounded positive reference u64 (java-render-type-reference-source.json)
ARCGEO08 and later: strict model-submit presence u8 after render-reference metadata; if 1, frame-local model ID u16 (1..2048), then copied root translation x/y/z f32 in the declared packet space

ARCGEO10: glint state u8 after model-submit metadata: 0 unknown, 1 explicit inactive, 2 active plus 40 f32 values (native-packet-glint-source.json); known state requires a wing model and exact state/uniform agreement across its parts
per vertex: position3 f32, normal3 f32, UV2 f32, ARGB u32, packed Java light u32
indices: u32 values with canonical Java quad pattern (0,1,2),(2,3,0) rebased per quad; empty batches preserve submit boundaries

flags.4: explicit packed scene-light source; absent for preview fallback and older packets
flags.8: supplied skin visibility source, only skin roles in v4+
flags.16: supplied Java layer eligibility, only cosmetic/glow/cape/wing/bent-skin roles in v6+

wire.sceneLightCompatibility: No byte layout change. Readers without bit 2 support reject flagged batches. Updated readers accept older unflagged staging but native lit-material preparation rejects it; emissive glow bypasses the lightmap.
wire.textureOrder: width u32, height u32, then width*height little-endian ARGB u32 values; not RGBA byte order
wire.phaseTrailer: After every texture: v9 requires positive collector epoch u64, phase count u8 (0..3), then ascending nonempty (order u8, stage u8, batch-count u32, batch indices u32). V10 first writes strict presence u8; 0 means unknown and 1 precedes those same records. Allowed keys (0,0),(0,8),(1,8), complete simple-role coverage and per-reference source order. These are owned avatar collector drains, not native phase ownership; see java-simple-phase-source.json.
wire.replayIdentity: Retains the unreduced rational sample as integers; f64 is pose math only and must match its projection
wire.modelSubmissions: Skin parts retain one model boundary, each cape one, and a wing pair one. All-hidden skin emits an empty batch. Decoder requires contiguous increasing model IDs and an unchanged actor, pass and bitwise root translation within a model. Earlier packets have unknown boundaries. Root translation does not establish Java view-space equivalence; native model ordering requires its separate owning pose input (java-model-submit-source.json).

consumer.jniRequest: ClientVm.geometry for the current software world; ClientVm.geometry_input for an owned exact no-readback observation; both remain unscheduled pending the native GPU input/phase producer
consumer.jniCopyBound: Check Java array length before copying into Rust
consumer.payloadOwnership: One Rust-owned packet allocation with bounded ranges for attributes, indices and texture pixels; no engine vector/destructor ownership
consumer.scopeLimitation: A matching packet identifies copied Java input for a requested frame. It does not prove a live engine lease, producer scope, completed upload or GPU submission. Future consumption must rejoin those independently.
